question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Tedious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Boring and tiresome**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Tedious"** means something that is too long, slow, or dull, and therefore causes boredom or weariness. (थकाऊ और उबाऊ)

 
 
• **Example:** The long lecture on ancient history was so tedious that many students fell asleep.
 
 
 
• **"Boring and tiresome"** refers to something that lacks excitement or interest, making it unappealing or exhausting. (उबाऊ और थकावट भरा)
 
 
• **Example:** Repeating the same task every day can become boring and tiresome over time.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate meaning of **"Tedious"** is **"Boring and tiresome"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Boring and tiresome**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exciting and fun** (रोमांचक और मजेदार): Something that is full of enthusiasm, energy, or enjoyment.

 
 
• **Example:** The amusement park ride was both exciting and fun for everyone.
 
 
 
• **Inspiring and uplifting** (प्रेरणादायक और उत्साहवर्धक): Something that motivates or makes you feel happy and encouraged.
 
 
• **Example:** The speech by the motivational speaker was truly inspiring and uplifting.
 
 
 
• **Brief and concise** (संक्षिप्त और सारगर्भित): Something that is short and to the point without unnecessary details.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager gave a brief and concise summary of the project goals.
